control.title: Personal data breach notification
control.description: On a personal data breach, inform affected Data Principals and the Data Protection Board without delay, and submit the detailed report to the Board within 72 hours.

implementation_notes: Covered by the incident response plan; CERT-In POC registered.
evidence_hint: Breach records with notification timestamps and copies of notices.
acceptance_criteria: Copies of notices to the Data Protection Board and affected people, or the procedure if there were none

criteria_coverage.criterion: Copies of notices to the Data Protection Board and affected people, or the procedure if there were none

requirements.title: Breach intimation to the Board and affected Data Principals
requirements.guidance: In the event of a personal data breach, inform the Data Protection Board and each affected Data Principal in the prescribed form and manner.

requirements.title: Incident response
requirements.guidance: Respond to incidents with a defined programme to contain, remediate and communicate.

requirements.title: Inform affected Data Principals without delay
requirements.guidance: On becoming aware of a breach, inform each affected Data Principal without delay in plain language, covering the nature and extent, likely consequences, mitigation taken, safety measures they can take, and a contact person.

requirements.title: Inform the Board without delay and within 72 hours in detail
requirements.guidance: Inform the Data Protection Board without delay, and within 72 hours of becoming aware (or a longer period allowed by the Board) submit details of the facts, mitigation, findings about the cause and the persons responsible, remedial measures and notifications made.

evidence.title: Personal data breach notification: how we do it
evidence.description: Covered by the incident response plan; CERT-In POC registered.

checks.message: A note is a statement, not proof. Attach the record, export or screenshot if one exists.
